body:
## Choose your plot size

Compare 5.56 Marla, 8 Marla, 10.89 Marla, 14.22 Marla and 1 Kanal options. Full-payment prices start at PKR 27.90 Lac. Share your budget and preferred dimensions for available plot numbers.

## Full-payment options

Ring Road Block plots are offered on full payment. If you are exploring a larger plot with installments, ask separately about possible K Block options for 10 marla and above, subject to current availability.

## Your complete price

The price plan includes development charges in plot cost and lists PKR 20,000 registration. Request an itemized quote confirming registration treatment and any other applicable amounts.

Preferred locations may carry premiums: 15% for main-road corner plots, 10% for main-road or proper-corner plots, and 5% for short-corner or certain other preferred locations. Ask which category applies to your shortlisted plot.

## Explore the exact location

Request the plot number marked on a current block plan, along with a location pin. Arrange a visit to see road access, plot boundaries and the surrounding area, or ask for a current walkthrough.

## Start your shortlist

Send your budget, preferred size and location preference on WhatsApp. We can help you compare suitable plots and confirm the complete quotation and next steps.
